act.how: The plan is your revenue calculator from the programme start ({s}). Actuals come from real connections (cost = Activation Key), package activations (cost = USD price of the token lot used × rate) and direct subscriptions: revenue after deductions minus the OTA Retained Amount — that is your commission.
